metadata.description: The AI and communication layer for running the business, with Odoo as the system of record: one setup for every role, governed outbound email, a live governance demo, every user's own workspace on Odoo, business administration over Odoo, and the admin control plane.

plugins.name: systemprompt-commons
plugins.description: What every role gets: the one workspace setup skill (installs every dashboard the plugins you were granted ship), the shared brand skill — voice, document formatting, company boilerplate — and outbound email that a second human approves before it leaves.

plugins.name: systemprompt-demo
plugins.description: Trip the governance pipeline on purpose and watch it answer: a call held for a second human, a secret refused before it costs anything, a destructive tool blocked by name — plus the full lead-to-factsheet-to-email arc that ends in a held send. Every beat is a real tool call; every outcome is an audit row.

plugins.name: systemprompt-workspace
plugins.description: What every signed-in user gets from Odoo: their own to-do list (activities and tasks, tick to complete), the open pipeline, upcoming deals grouped by tag and ordered by close date, and the team's recent notes — four live dashboards and one skill that reads them into a short brief. Every call runs as you; Odoo's record rules decide what appears.

plugins.name: systemprompt-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only: run the business from Odoo — what has been happening, and the leads that need a status — plus the control plane underneath it: operate the stack, prove governance live, and read back what every task cost. Ships the systemprompt CLI and knowledge-bank servers and seven live dashboards — including the brain@ inbox feed and the approval queue that is the only route from an email into Odoo.
